anomalies.observed: Several keyboard matrix lines are connected to SKW92A pins whose declared functions are Ethernet PHY signals. For example, U7.7 (COL1) shares NET0031 with U11.5 (LAN_PORT1_TX+), and U7.9 (COL2) shares NET0014 with U11.6 (LAN_PORT1_TX-); other keyboard columns and rows likewise connect to LAN_PORT1/2/3 pins.
anomalies.expected: The keyboard row and column lines should connect to GPIO-capable module pins, as described in the specification, rather than pins assigned to Ethernet PHY signals.

evidence.quote: netlist shows 5 column + 7 row lines wired directly to SKW92A GPIO pins (matrix scanned by the module itself, not via an onboard keyboard controller)

anomalies.impact: Keyboard scanning on these lines will interact with Ethernet PHY signals rather than independent GPIOs, so the keyboard matrix is unlikely to work as intended and may interfere with PHY operation.

parsed.summary: The keyboard matrix is not wired exclusively to GPIO-capable pins: multiple row/column nets share SKW92A pins identified in the netlist as Ethernet PHY signals. This contradicts the specified GPIO matrix interface and is likely to impair keyboard operation.
